field.name: includeCurrent
field.comment: true: the page holding the block is the last step of the breadcrumb; false: the breadcrumb stops at its parent page

field.name: ignoreExcludeNav
field.comment: true: the pages whose exclude_nav attribute is set are listed too; false: they are left out, as the navigation blocks leave them out

field.name: ignorePermission
field.comment: true: the pages that the visitor is not allowed to view are listed too; false: they are left out
